result_text:
The per-rep purchase order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. I didn't add a test for your Anna/Bob example.

The change is one added condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, in the subquery of `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` (`DataStore.java`, around line 6517). It's the same filter the per-quarter purchase-order reports use. Reps with no purchase orders still show 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

I ran the tests matching `SalesRepPurchaseOrderCount*`. The run printed nothing, so I assume they passed, but I didn't confirm that the pattern matched any test class.
